description: Accounting (shown): each company's journal and trial balance, and the group's consolidation with its eliminations. v = fxFinance.accounting(store.get(), { le, kind }) built on fxViews.ledger / consolidation, set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh; the company switch and the kind filter go through pickChain, exports through exportChain, links through openChain (docs/redesign/BUILDING-FUTURE-SCREENS.md). Never posts anything.

v.description: fxFinance.accounting(state, { le, kind, statementNav }) plus me.

le.description: The company shown (a legal entity id, or GROUP); empty: the persona's first company.

kind.description: The journal's kind filter (a transaction kind; empty: all).

exportOpen.description: Which list's export menu is open.

failure.description: The last failure, in words, kept on the page until the next thing works.

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
